<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/carriers/{scac}/suspensions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Suspends an `ACTIVE` carrier with a mandatory `reason` (1..200 characters). From now on a booking or reschedule naming its SCAC is
refused with 409 `carrier-suspended`. Appointments the carrier already holds are NOT cancelled: a person decides about them (the
`CarrierSuspended` event lets other contexts react). 409 `carrier-already-suspended` when it is already suspended. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`; `If-Match` with the `ETag` is honoured (412 on mismatch). Publishes `CarrierSuspended`.
